chars.T: TAHA: a slim nervous young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, grey sweatpants and white socks.
chars.K: KARIM: a tall young man wearing a maroon tracksuit with two white stripes down the sleeves and legs.
chars.M: MOUNIR: a stocky young man wearing a teal denim jacket over a white t-shirt and black jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night inside a big rural Moroccan farmhouse near Safi. TAHA stands frozen halfway on a tiled staircase in the dark, holding the railing, leaning to listen toward a dim kitchen doorway at the bottom, scared wide eyes. Moonlight through a small window.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night outside a big rural Moroccan farmhouse near Safi with white walls and a blue door. Two shadowy hooded village thieves sneak along the wall toward the kitchen window, crouching, under a dark blue sky with stars and olive trees.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark hallway of a Moroccan farmhouse. TAHA stands with his back against the wall, sweating, holding a phone with its flashlight on, thinking hard and nervous.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, at the front gate of a Moroccan farmhouse. KARIM and MOUNIR tiptoe in secretly, looking around guiltily, KARIM holding a finger to his lips, a small old white car parked behind them.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, a tiny village grocery shop in rural Morocco near Safi with a lit doorway. KARIM and MOUNIR stand at the counter whispering to each other secretly, carrying plastic bags.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Very dark bedroom of a Moroccan farmhouse with traditional sofas. TAHA sits up in his bed under a blanket, suddenly awake, worried, a round wall clock showing three o'clock on the wall.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, long dark tiled corridor of a Moroccan farmhouse. TAHA walks slowly on tiptoe toward the sound, phone flashlight in front of him, scared.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, upstairs corridor of a Moroccan farmhouse. A closed wooden bedroom door with warm light leaking from under it. TAHA stands a few steps away pointing at the door, shocked, realizing the sound comes from that room.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Night, close view in a farmhouse corridor. TAHA presses his ear against a closed wooden bedroom door, listening, his eyes wide open in total shock, mouth open.
